scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @angry-carp/checks && npm run build --workspace @angry-carp/cli
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test --workspaces && node --test scripts/*.test.mjs
scripts.check:types: npm run build && npm run check:types --workspaces
scripts.lint: npm run build && oxlint lib/src cli/src agent/src cli/build-resources.mjs scripts --deny-warnings --report-unused-disable-directives && npm run lint:structure
scripts.brands:check: npm run build && npm run brands:check --workspace @angry-carp/checks
scripts.analyze: npm run build && node cli/dist/main.js analyze
scripts.extract:links: npm run build && node cli/dist/main.js extract-links
scripts.report: npm run build && node cli/dist/main.js report
